tools.name: validate_target_context
tools.description: Validate the already registered target, exact sequence frame, supported objective and protected positions. Does not edit target or grant spending permission.

tools.name: retrieve_atlas_evidence
tools.description: Read the pinned sanitized Biohub Atlas snapshot for the exact registered WT full_212 reference only. No live search, variant upload or folding occurs. Returns one existing record, not homolog hits or variant-effect evidence; optional context never changes baseline ranking.

tools.name: score_positions
tools.description: Request masked marginal scores at registered reference positions. Reuse all substitutions at a position. The verifier is optional annotation, not an automatic mixed-model rerank. One run keeps one checkpoint: the model is chosen once per run and cannot be switched mid-run, so verifier scores are never blended into a baseline ranking.

tools.name: fetch_atlas_structure
tools.description: Fetch a predicted structure for an accession already verified in this run. This is a reference/homolog structure, not a new candidate prediction.

tools.name: predict_structure
tools.description: OPTIONAL: predict the exact registered candidate sequence, only when the server has enabled this tool and approved a structure budget. No claim of thermostability follows from this result.

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Return server-owned current state, known artifacts and approved remaining limits. Never changes limits. The backend handles waiting; do not poll repeatedly.
